what: Card sets (three per page) are paged with arrows: the current page’s cards drop 14px and vanish over .42s, starting from the left at 90ms intervals. Once all are gone, the next page’s cards appear at the same interval, falling in from 14px above (ease). Arrows are locked while paging. Paging past the end loops back to the start

options.[data-fx-part=page]: Page (child) — put is-active on the first page to start from it. If none, the first page
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Cards inside the page — delayed in this order

use:
…×3
…
(pages are stacked in a single cell — grid-area 1/1)

from.where: index.html .coll — original collection slider: CARD_MS 420 · STAGGER_MS 90, exit is-leaving (downward) then enter (from above), page length 420 + (card count−1)×90, arrows disabled while paging, switches instantly under reduced motion.
